items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: at that time I was too young to know him.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. In 1945, he played at Taboo. He was the first musician French to play at the Jazz in New Orleans. In fact, I think he was the first, before Luther. Because he played during the war, at that time I was too young to know him. But I know that he started in 1945, at Taboo, to play jazz with others, before Luther started, because Luther started commercially in 1947 and 1948.
Did he get his inspiration from anyone? That's what I'm getting at. Did you say that? Did he have an inspiration? Armstrong, Oliver, Tommy Ladnere? Did he play like anyone or was he original?
